title: Module-object Postnikov Roos cone
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, let $p:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes, and let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$. Here module objects and their derived direct image $Rp_*$ are those of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Form the inverse tower $A_n=\tau_{\geq -n}K$ with its canonical truncation transitions and its canonical cone with vertex $K$ and legs $K\to A_n$. Applying $Rp_*$ to this entire cone produces a homotopy-limit cone: its canonical map to $\prod_n Rp_*A_n$ is the first map of a distinguished Roos triangle with second map $1-T$. Moreover, for every integer $j$, the functor $H^j:D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Y})\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Y}$ preserves products indexed by $\mathbb N$. No properness or boundedness assumption is required.

proof.text: Apply the actual internal/sectionwise module equivalence to transfer exact countable products from pro-etale module sheaves. The general derived-category product and homology preservation instances then apply to the internal module categories.

Complete 1-T on the product of canonical lower truncations to a distinguished triangle with first object L. Exactness factors the canonical cone map K -> product through L, preserving all legs. In each degree the canonical truncation projections are eventually isomorphisms; cone naturality gives the same for the transitions. Apply the eventual Milnor projection theorem to L to see that K -> L induces isomorphisms on all cohomology, hence is an isomorphism. Transport the homotopy-limit cone along its inverse.

The derived upper-star/lower-star adjunction makes direct image a right adjoint and hence product preserving. Its K-injective derived construction is triangulated. Map the whole canonical homotopy-limit cone, retaining the canonical truncation projection maps.

proof_origin.place: Limit presentation; direct derived-category proof from exact products and eventual Milnor projections

theorem moduleObjectDerivedPushforward_postnikov_roos
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)) :
    IsHomotopyLimit ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ p).mapCone
      (DerivedCategory.lowerPostnikovCone K)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℤ, PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ)
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ Y) j))
